record.paper_title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
record.original_question: If X is a well-filtered determined T0 space, is its Smyth power space PS(X), the upper Vietoris space on nonempty compact saturated subsets of X, also well-filtered determined?

evidence.quote: Question 6.5. ([51]) Is the Smyth power space PS (X) of a well-filtered determined T0 space X well-filtered determined?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a T0 topological space. A subset A ⊆ X is saturated if it equals the intersection of its open neighborhoods (equivalently, A is an upper set in the specialization order of X). A space Y is called well-filtered if for every filtered family {K_i : i ∈ I} of nonempty compact saturated subsets of Y and every open set U ⊆ Y with ⋂_{i∈I} K_i ⊆ U, there exists some i₀ ∈ I with K_{i₀} ⊆ U.

A continuous map f : X → Y from X to a well-filtered space Y is called a well-filtered reflection if for every continuous map g : X → Z into a well-filtered space Z there exists a unique continuous map h : Y → Z with h ∘ f = g. The space X is said to be well-filtered determined if for every continuous map g : X → Z into a well-filtered T0 space Z, there exists a (necessarily unique) continuous map ĝ : X^w → Z extending g through the well-filtered reflection X → X^w; equivalently, X has a well-filtered reflection that is obtained as the topological quotient/embedding determined by X itself in the standard way (so that continuous maps from X into well-filtered T0 spaces are in bijection with continuous maps from its well-filtered reflection).

Let P_S(X) denote the Smyth power space of X: its underlying set is the collection K(X) of all nonempty compact saturated subsets of X, equipped with the upper Vietoris topology, which is generated by the basic open sets □U = { K ∈ K(X) : K ⊆ U } as U ranges over the open subsets of X.

Question: If X is a well-filtered determined T0 space, must the Smyth power space P_S(X) also be well-filtered determined?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is listed as an open problem in the literature on well-filtered spaces. Recent works (2019–2026) on well-filtered determined spaces, ω-Rudin spaces, and Smyth power constructions discuss related results (e.g., well-filteredness of Smyth power spaces, strong well-filteredness on sup-complete posets) but no source located confirms a resolution of this specific question about preservation of "well-filtered determined" under the Smyth power construction. Status appears to remain open, but this could not be definitively verified.

status_evidence.title: On T0 spaces determined by well-filtered spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces well-filtered determined T0 spaces and studies their reflections; related questions on Smyth power spaces are raised.
status_evidence.claim: The notion of well-filtered determined space is introduced and related open problems are formulated.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Collects open problems including whether the Smyth power space of a well-filtered determined T0 space is well-filtered determined.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is explicitly listed among open problems.

status_evidence.title: S*-well-filtered spaces and d*-spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2026) study of related variants of well-filteredness for Smyth power spaces; does not resolve the WD-preservation question.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work studies related but distinct notions without settling this particular problem.
